description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice Calling for claims to Land Parcels Gamsabha Malmillewa, Palagala D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 310243 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land and property-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title registration, cadastral mapping, and determination of land ownership rights across multiple districts. The content focuses entirely on land administration processes without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
